notes: Balance-sheet lines now sourced from the bank's own published annual accounts (btgpactual.eu/downloads), not estimated.

YE2024 metrics use the IFRS basis (audited comparative in the FY2025 accounts). Net loss under IFRS was EUR 1.554m; under Lux GAAP statutory accounts it was EUR 0.936m (the figure Moody's rounded to EUR 0.94m).

Own funds are public via Pillar 3: CET1 = Tier 1 = Total capital = EUR 206,291,697 at 31 Dec 2024; RWA (total risk exposure amount) = EUR 360,699,089; audited CET1 ratio = 57.19%. Moody's cited ~65% (approximation; does not match the audited Pillar 3 reference date).

Public disclosure cadence is ANNUAL: audited annual accounts (Lux GAAP + IFRS from FY2025) and an annual Pillar 3 Disclosure Report. No open monthly/quarterly per-bank supervisory dump exists for Luxembourg.

Latest audited period is YE2025 (assets EUR 1,258m; equity EUR 415.5m; deposits EUR 551.8m; net profit EUR 2.97m; CET1 EUR 402.8m; CET1 ratio 59.42%). Seed kept at YE2024 (period 202412); bump to 202512 when desired.
Former FIS Privatbank S.A.; renamed BTG Pactual Europe S.A. on 15 Jan 2024. Subscribed capital EUR 9,989,000; share premium EUR 205m at YE2024 (EUR 405m at YE2025).
